note: Shared UX strings catalog (S-2). Coordinator-owned. Each entry has en (shared, or the GNOME text when platforms differ) and an optional mac. status: drawn = on a board; harmony = required by HARMONY.md, not drawn; format = reference to a format-vectors formatter; vectors = only required by the vectors; galleryOnly = only on the hidden states-gallery debug board, never shipped; legacy = temporary, has an end milestone; pending = copy awaiting Silvio. Placeholders are {name}. Typographic ’ “ ” are part of the strings. Only ship entries whose milestone you are implementing.
